title: Global A4=57 fixed-parent extremality, active-mixer optimization, six-model photon protocol, literal rank-48 tensor, Monster gate, and three constructions
result: Global A4=57 extremality is proved among doubly-even self-orthogonal extensions containing the fixed [36,6,16] parent code. The 945-word compatibility graph has O6-(2) orbits 135+810; exact clique searches give orbit maxima 15 and 54, while the fixed-representative neighborhood search proves the global bound 57, attained by an explicit [36,17,4] code. Its weight-four graph is T(10) disjoint union 2T(4), and its coordinate stabilizer has order 192. The common-order exact mesh remains 398=302 genuine mixers+96 signed swaps in 69 layers and is radius-one optimal over all 630 transpositions; allowing distinct input/output orders yields 401=296 genuine mixers+105 signed swaps, removing six active mixers, while an exact fixed-order cut argument gives lower bound 253. The six-model photon protocol separates invariant-front direct-sum capacity, transverse-structure group delay, a hidden-node falsifier, engineered W33 graph kinetics with 0:10:16 sectors, hyperentangled tensor factors, and self-similar coupling efficiency. The rank-48 algebra is closed both in split Wedderburn coordinates and as a literal 48-relation orbital tensor containing 904 nonzero intersection constants, tensor SHA-256 a17a375552c102d281e3ba79b602b67aa54a426fd68b1878293763ea65395ff9. The Monster gate remains fail-closed.
